content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) Fortran source of FUNWAVE-TVD masks.F containing the single subroutine UPDATE_MASK (L62-175; header L57-58 notes mask is also updated in the fluxes subroutine; Shi 05/28/2010), the wetting-drying mask update called each Runge-Kutta stage. Algorithm: allocate temporaries MASKtmp/MASK9tmp/ETAtmp (L69-70), exchange ghost values of MASK and MASK9 (L74-75), copy MASKtmp=MASK (L77), zero the mass-correction accumulator Dmass (L80). Loop J=Jbeg-2,Jend+2 / I=Ibeg-2,Iend+2 (L83-84): for non-structure cells (MASK_STRUC==1, L86) — flooding: a dry cell (MASK<1, L87) becomes wet if Eta(I,J)>-Depth(I,J) (rainfall case comment L89, L90-92) or if any of the four neighbors is wet with higher Eta (left L94-96, right L98-100, bottom L102-104, top L106-108); drying: a wet cell with Eta(I,J)<-Depth(I,J) is set dry (MASKtmp=0, L111-112) and, inside the interior window, Dmass accumulates (ETAtmp(I,J)-ETA(I,J))*DX*DY (L116-118) — the version 3.4 lines that would set ETAtmp (ETAtmp=ETA @L79 and ETAtmp(I,J)=MinDepth-Depth(I,J) @L114) are commented out. Independently of MASK_STRUC, dry cells get locally flattened interface depths DepthX(I,J)=Depth(I-1,J), DepthX(I+1,J)=Depth(I+1,J), DepthY(I,J)=Depth(I,J-1), DepthY(I,J+1)=Depth(I,J+1) (L130-135; rationale comments L123-129: avoids extreme depth gradients on drying, 01/21/2012, with the Choi Thacker-bowl accuracy caveat 07/03/2016 and the -DIGNORE_BIG_SLOPE Makefile alternative). Then MASK=MASKtmp (L141; version 3.4 ETA=ETAtmp also commented @L143). Second loop J=Jbeg-1,Jend+1 / I=Ibeg-1,Iend+1 (L146-147): if VISCOSITY_BREAKING, MASK9tmp=1 everywhere (comment: dont use mask9 for viscosity breaking, L148-150); else MASK9tmp = product of MASK over the 3x3 neighborhood (L152-154) and additionally zeroed where |Eta|/MAX(DEPTH,MinDepthFrc)>SWE_ETA_DEP (shallow-water-equation switch, L155-157). MASK9=MASK9tmp (L164), final PHI_INT_EXCH of MASK and MASK9 (L167-168), deallocate (L170-171).

equations.ref: mass change on drying, interior window guard @L116
SWE switch: MASK9tmp=ZERO @L156 where nonlinearity ratio exceeds SWE_ETA_DEP

verbatim_spans.text: !       note that mask also be updated in fluxes subroutine
! dont use mask9 for viscosity breaking
! In Makefile, define -DIGNORE_BIG_SLOPE to ignore big slopes

unresolved: Dmass accumulation (L117) reads ETAtmp which is never assigned in this version — both assignments (ETAtmp=ETA @L79, ETAtmp(I,J)=MinDepth-Depth(I,J) @L114) are commented out as 'version 3.4', so Dmass sums an uninitialized array; whether Dmass is consumed anywhere is cross-file
local myvar (L67) is declared but unused
the flood test IF(Eta(I,J)>-Depth(I,J)) at L90 wets a cell regardless of neighbors (marked 'rainfall case $$$' @L89), overlapping the neighbor-based tests that follow

the depth-flattening block (L130-135) uses the OLD MASK (not MASKtmp), so cells drying in this very call keep unflattened DepthX/DepthY until the next call — ordering relation between L111-112 and L130-135

MASK9 zeroing by the SWE_ETA_DEP criterion couples to fluxes.F where MASK9 multiplies the dispersion terms (cross-file); Dmass, MASK_STRUC, SWE_ETA_DEP, VISCOSITY_BREAKING, phi_int_exch are defined cross-file
